statement:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),
  Continuous f →
    ∀ (n : ℝ),
      ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, ↑(f x) * Complex.exp (-(↑n * ↑x * Complex.I)) =
        ↑(∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * cos (n * x)) - ↑(∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * sin (n * x)) * Complex.I

integrals.function: fun x => f x * cos (n * x)
fun x => f x * sin (n * x)

goal.text:
∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, ↑(f x) * Complex.exp (-(↑n * ↑x * Complex.I)) =
  ↑(∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * cos (n * x)) - ↑(∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * sin (n * x)) * Complex.I
goal.rhs: ↑(∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * cos (n * x)) - ↑(∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, f x * sin (n * x)) * Complex.I
goal.lhs: ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..2 * π, ↑(f x) * Complex.exp (-(↑n * ↑x * Complex.I))
goal.expr: (definite_integral((F_f(i0_) * exp((-((x4 * i0_) * I)))), i0_, 0, (2 * pi))) - ((definite_integral((F_f(i0_) * cos((x4 * i0_))), i0_, 0, (2 * pi)) - (definite_integral((F_f(i0_) * sin((x4 * i0_))), i0_, 0, (2 * pi)) * I)))
